engines.description: Symbolic-execution engines (Triton + Z3) for F1 clean-room synthesis and F3 path exploration. Heavy: the first build recompiles them from source (~30+ min). Enable with the 'engines' manifest feature AND define DS_HAVE_SYMENGINE; the default build uses the stub engine + the pure DefaultSolver so it stays fast.

embed-python.description: Embed CPython for the F2 hot-patch Python tier (a snippet sets `patch = bytes([...])`). Enable with the 'embed-python' manifest feature AND /p:DsPython=true (defines DS_HAVE_PYTHON). Adds ~25MB to the exe; the Asm tier needs none of this.
